_capture.method: fetched with the Arena fetch tool (the development sandbox has no outbound network; CI does)
_capture.completeness: Complete response bodies, one per series checked, exactly as returned. Each is an empty market list with an empty cursor.
_capture.why_it_matters: A VERIFIED NEGATIVE, kept so the absence is documented instead of being re-discovered or, worse, filled in with an invented contract. On 2026-09-21 (preseason) Kalshi listed the series KXNHL1P, KXNHLOVERTIME and KXNHLSAVES in /series?category=Sports&tags=Hockey but had NO open contracts in them, and KXNHL1P had no historical-tier contracts either. Consequence recorded in the source registry and on the site: period and goalie-prop markets are registered and polled every run, but nothing may be bet on them until the exchange actually lists a contract, and no price for them is ever inferred.
